And if we try to reroute the bishop this way, black is going to promote to a queen and stop the bishop from coming in. So instead, we need to go to E4 and force black to promote to a knight. So that now the F3 square is defended and there's no checkmate. But wait, the game is not over. We have other routes to get to the black king.
